correctness.rationale: All-size proof explicitly derives round-two values \(\binom{n-2k+s}{k}\) and \(\binom{n-2k+t}{k}\); strict monotonicity follows from the positive adjacent binomial difference for \(n\ge3k-1\). An exact ordered-pair double-counting formula for the round-three weighted neighbor moment recovers \(r=|X\cap A\cap B|\) with positive coefficient \(\binom{n-k-2}{k-1}\). Every four-region profile is one orbit by within-region permutations, while all stabilizer automorphisms preserve the colours. A direct \(KG(8,3)\) pair is indistinguishable through round two and has moments 12 and 15 at round three. Verification scripts confirm 42 refinement configurations (9,263 vertices) and 28 moment/size configurations (4,723 vertices). These finite tests are not claimed as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Provides a complete, exact and uniform three-round reconstruction of pointwise-stabilizer orbits for infinitely many highly symmetric Kneser graphs, with an explicit multivariate class-size formula. The class-recovery mechanism (a mixed weighted disjoint-neighbour moment) is structurally different from landmark distance or mere group-action knowledge, and a concrete sharpness example establishes necessity of a third round. The \(n\ge3k-1\) threshold is motivated by strict injectivity of a natural common-neighbour invariant. Such orbit information is relevant to graph individualization and logical symmetry analysis without implying full \(C^2\) graph identification.
